fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 4001 New York Ave, Arlington TX - CJ Logistics America food-grade DC. Large multi-tenant cross-dock warehouse in a dense DFW industrial park; CJ Logistics occupies a ~50,000 SF portion (per CJ open-space page). Hobby Lobby trailers visible at the docks indicate a major co-tenant.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open multi-tenant industrial park. No perimeter fence enclosing the whole site and no barrier arm/checkpoint at any driveway. Truck-court driveways on the east and south connect to internal park roads via open curb cuts (2026-March Street View). Some partial chain-link fencing screens portions of the east dock court but does not gate the entrances.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any driveway.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: True - cross-dock building with dock banks on BOTH the east face and the west face, each fronting its own truck court.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock doors along both the east and west faces; estimated ~90 doors total - low-confidence overhead count.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailers parked in the wide east truck court, separate from the dock apron - functions as a drop yard though stalls are loosely marked.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Arlington TX, dense DFW industrial corridor near the airport/intermodal - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
